characters.name: Mara
characters.description: A retired smuggler with a debt to settle.

content.text: Rain hammers the slate roofs above the Duke's manor.

content.speaker: elena
content.text: *Elena unrolls a soaked map.* Two guards on the east stair. We go at the eighth bell.

content.speaker: kai
content.text: Or we go now, while they're drunk. *He grins at {{user}}.* Your call, boss.

content.speaker: mara
content.text: We wait for the eighth bell. Kai, you take the east stair.

content.speaker: kai
content.text: East stair. Sure. *He's gone before anyone can stop him.*

changes.reason: Kai left for the east stair, uneasy.

content.text: The seventh bell rolls across the harbor.

content.speaker: kai
content.text: *Kai hesitates, then nods.* Fine. Your plan, boss. For once.

content.speaker: kai
content.text: *If the Duke's men are early, this ends badly for all of us.*

changes.reason: An hour passed; Mara trusted Kai with the stair.

entries.text: Mara gave Kai the east stair, the post closest to the Duke's trap.
